phone: The number shown and called. Leave empty to use the store phone from **Settings › Store details**.
label: Optional text before the number, for example “Call us”. Hidden on smaller screens. Leave empty: the button shows the icon and the number.
hide_in_drawer: Leave off: on phones and tablets the phone becomes a square call button.
aria_label: What screen readers say before the number. Keep “Call”.
ts_style: **Primary, neutral** makes it the black button. Keep it.
